dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - July 26, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Tampa Bay Rays Edge Past Guardians 1-0 in Thrilling Match**

Drew Rasmussen delivered a masterful performance, tossing 7 shutout innings with 9 strikeouts, while Bryan Baker earned the save in the Rays' 1-0 win over the Guardians. Chandler Simpson's scoring single on a Cedric Mullins bunt pop was the lone run of the game. Meanwhile, Parker Messick took the loss for the Guardians, allowing just 1 earned run on 1 hit in 6 innings.

**Nationals' Balanced Attack Stuns Diamondbacks 10-7**

The Washington Nationals exploded for 10 runs, led by CJ Abrams' 2-homer, 3-RBI performance. Abrams finished 3-for-5 with 3 runs scored. Riley Cornelio earned the win, while Jonathan Loáisiga took the loss for the Diamondbacks. The Nationals' victory was marked by a staff effort, with multiple players contributing to the offense.

**Braves Escape with 3-2 Win over Orioles**

Reynaldo López tossed 5.2 scoreless innings with 6 strikeouts to lead the Atlanta Braves to a 3-2 win over the Baltimore Orioles. Tyler Kinley earned the win, while Andrew Kittredge took the loss for the Orioles. Pete Alonso hit a solo homer for the Braves, while Drake Baldwin and Dominic Smith also contributed to the offense.

**Padres Outlast Marlins 5-3 in Slugfest**

Manny Machado hit a 3-RBI homer to lead the San Diego Padres to a 5-3 win over the Miami Marlins. Wandy Peralta earned the win, while Mason Miller recorded the save. Jake Cronenworth and Luis Rengifo also homered for the Padres, while Ty France and Jackson Merrill contributed to the offense.

**Twins Come from Behind to Top Athletics 11-8**

Munetaka Murakami homered twice and drove in 6 runs to lead the Minnesota Twins to an 11-8 win over the Oakland Athletics. Connor Prielipp earned the win, while Jeffrey Springs took the loss for the Athletics. The Twins' victory was marked by a staff effort, with multiple players contributing to the offense.

**Brewers Rout Rockies 11-2 behind Misiorowski's 12 Strikeouts**

Jacob Misiorowski tossed 5 shutout innings with 12 strikeouts to lead the Milwaukee Brewers to an 11-2 win over the Colorado Rockies. Andrew Vaughn homered for the Brewers, while Cole Carrigg and Willie Castro also contributed to the offense.

**Reds Outlast Cardinals 5-3 in Thrilling Match**

Elly De La Cruz hit a solo homer to lead the Cincinnati Reds to a 5-3 win over the St. Louis Cardinals. Brock Burke earned the win, while Julian Garcia recorded the save. Kyle Leahy tossed 6 strong innings with 9 strikeouts for the Reds, while Alec Burleson and Iván Herrera also contributed to the offense.

**Mariners Outlast Rangers 6-4**

Dominic Canzone homered and drove in 4 runs to lead the Seattle Mariners to a 6-4 win over the Texas Rangers. Andrés Muñoz earned the win and recorded the save, while Cole Winn took the loss for the Rangers.
